Able to prioritize work based on business and customer demands, required
Able to work within middle to upper levels of the organization, required
Able to articulate concepts and ideas to a non-technical audience, required

Able to understand and train others on electrical and mechanical systems, as well as other technical aspects of facilities management, required
Able to read and understand complex drawings, systems and other documentation, required
Experience creating, managing, and maintaining service catalogs and SLAs, required

description:
Company Description

Battle-Tested Leadership Experience
100% Data Center Focused

Do you have strong commercial and administrative skills, a good understanding of financial matters, and a natural ability to create structure and build strong relationships?

As Contract Support Lead, you will play an important role in the day-to-day management and development of a significant contract. You will work closely on-site with our Critical Facilities Director and play a central role in collaborating with the client, the on-site team, and our US leadership team.

This is a role where you need to be detail-oriented, understand the business, and be able to see what it takes to create a great customer experience and a healthy contract.

A key role close to both the Client and Leadership

The overall responsibility for the contract sits with our Critical Facilities Director, but you will be a key player in the day-to-day follow-up on the contract's commercial, financial, and administrative matters. Moreover, you will be part of the initial part of MSA (Master Service Agreement) and responsible for the SOW (Scope of Work) and overall vendor management.

You will help ensure that we deliver on our agreements, maintain strong financial control, and continuously develop our relationship with the client.

An important part of the role is also working closely with our US leadership team. You will be expected to provide a clear and professional overview of the contract's status, financial performance, operational performance, and development opportunities, while ensuring that information and decisions are effectively translated into action within the local organization.

The customer is at the heart of this role. You will play a significant part in the ongoing customer dialogue and will be expected to understand, meet, and ideally anticipate the customer's needs. You should be able to build trust and strong relationships while also having the confidence to engage in commercial and operational discussions when required.

Your Key Responsibilities

You will, among other things:

Act as a close business partner to the Critical Facilities Director in the day-to-day management of the contract
Take responsibility for the ongoing Contract Support function, ensuring structure, quality, and progress
Vendor life cycle management
Support the financial and commercial performance of the contract
Follow up on KPIs, financial performance, and relevant contract reporting
Contribute to monthly reporting and QBR’s – Quarterly Business Reviews
Ensure accurate and timely customer invoicing and follow-up on subcontractor invoices
Maintain a strong understanding of the contract scope, terms and conditions, and commercial aspects
Act as an important point of contact in the ongoing dialogue with the customer
Coordinate and administer relevant helpdesk and asset management systems
Identify opportunities for improvement and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives
Ensure effective communication and information flow between the client, the on-site team, the Critical Facilities Director, and our US leadership team

Who are You?

We are looking for someone with experience in service delivery management, contract coordination, contract management, facilities management, or a similar commercial/administrative role.

You do not necessarily need to come from exactly the same type of position. What matters most is that you have the commercial understanding, structure, and drive needed to succeed in the role.

We would like you to have:

Experience with contract administration or commercial operations
Experience with vendor management
Experience with finance, invoicing, and reporting
Experience in a client-facing role
Experience with people management, coordination, or employee development is an advantage
Strong analytical and organizational skills
Good numerical understanding and strong Excel/spreadsheet skills
Excellent communication skills in both Danish and English
The ability to work in a structured and independent manner while managing multiple deadlines
Experience with systems such as Coupa and NetSuite

You are the type of person who...

...creates clarity when there are many moving parts.

You are detail-oriented without losing sight of the commercial perspective. You take ownership, follow through, and make sure things get done.

You are a people person and thrive on working across an organization. You can communicate effectively with the client on one side and leadership on the other, and you understand how to adapt your communication to both.

You thrive in an international organization and are comfortable collaborating across countries and cultures.

And most importantly: You keep the client at the center and are motivated by creating results through strong collaboration.

title: Control Room Specialist
description:
Control Room Specialist
Location: Viborg, Denmark
Employment: Full-time, 35 hours per week
Working hours: Shift work supporting 24/7 data center operations
Do you thrive in a technical environment where reliability, safety and attention to detail are critical?
We are looking for aControl Room Specialist (CRS) to join our team in Viborg. In this role, you will play a key part in ensuring the continuous and reliable operation of critical data center infrastructure.
As a Control Room Specialist, you will monitor and respond to critical systems, alarms and environmental conditions, while working closely with technicians and other teams to maintain high availability and minimize operational and safety risks.
This is a role for someone who enjoys working with complex technical systems, stays calm under pressure and takes pride in doing things right.
Your role
As part of the operations team, you will be a central point of contact for the data center's critical and non-critical infrastructure. You will monitor systems, respond to alarms and incidents, support troubleshooting and contribute to continuous improvements in operational excellence.
Your responsibilities will include:
Monitoring and operating critical and non-critical data center infrastructure and systems
Responding promptly to alarms and alerts and taking appropriate action to minimize downtime
Acting as an incident specialist and coordinating with cross-functional teams during incidents
Monitoring power, cooling capacity and environmental conditions within the data halls
Working with BMS, SCADA, CMMS, Fire Life Safety and network systems
Supporting troubleshooting, analysis and optimization of technical systems
Performing facility rounds of SCADA/BMS systems and physical inspections of the facility
Supporting and guiding operators, technicians and other relevant personnel
Developing, reviewing, auditing and executing operating procedures, standards and specifications
Supporting change control activities and ensuring procedures are followed
Working with and escorting external contractors while ensuring compliance with facility rules
Participating in training, construction and commissioning activities as required
Contributing to continuous improvement and operational excellence
Working shifts to support 24/7 data center operations and being flexible when coverage of other shifts is required
What we're looking for
We are looking for a technically minded and responsible professional who can maintain focus in a high-pressure environment and who understands the importance of safety, reliability and attention to detail.
You ideally have:
Technical education or training, preferably as an Electrician, Marine Engineer or Cooling Technician
Experience from a control room environment, including monitoring BMS, SCADA and Fire Life Safety systems
Experience with automation, CTS, CR, SCADA, networks and servers
1–3+ years of experience in a mission-critical environment, such as a data center, shipping, power/heat plant or oil & gas
Electrical or mechanical certification/licence
The ability to read and understand electrical and mechanical manuals, drawings and sketches
The ability to work safely and proficiently with hand and power tools
Who you are
You are a team player with strong communication skills and a practical, solution-oriented mindset. You remain calm when things get busy and are comfortable taking responsibility when an issue needs to be resolved.
We value someone who:
Communicates effectively in English, both verbally and in writing
Has strong problem-solving and analytical skills
Is comfortable working in a high-pressure environment
Has a strong attention to detail and takes pride in their work
Has a positive, can-do attitude
Works well as part of a team and contributes to a positive working environment
Can adapt to changing priorities and operational needs
Is proactive, reliable and willing to step in when needed
Has good technical writing skills and can contribute to MOPs, SOPs and EOPs
A role where you can grow
We believe in continuous learning and development. As part of the role, you will participate in structured training and development, with expectations to complete:
Level I training within 60 days
Level II training modules within 6 months
Level III training modules within 9 months
Why this role matters
Data centers depend on reliable infrastructure around the clock. As a Control Room Specialist, you will be one of the people ensuring that critical systems are continuously monitored, issues are identified quickly and the facility operates safely and efficiently.
If you enjoy technical responsibility, teamwork, problem-solving and working in an environment where every detail matters, this could be the opportunity for you.
We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Critical Facilities Director
description:
Are you an experienced leader with a passion for operational excellence, people leadership and building trusted client relationships?

As Critical Facilities Director, you will lead our Critical Facilities organization and serve as the senior operational partner for one of our most important clients. You will be responsible for ensuring the reliable operation of critical infrastructure while driving operational excellence, developing the organization and maintaining a strong, long-term client
relationship.

This is a senior leadership role where success is measured not only by operational performance, but by your ability to develop people, strengthen collaboration with the client and continuously improve the business.

Working closely with the client, internal stakeholders and external service partners, you will ensure that our operations consistently deliver the highest standards of reliability, safety and service.

The Role

As Critical Facilities Director, you will provide both strategic and operational leadership for our Critical Facilities organization. You will lead through your managers and technical specialists, ensuring that the organization delivers operational excellence while meeting the client's business goals and expectations.You will act as the trusted operational advisor to the client, coordinating across internal teams and external suppliers to ensure seamless service delivery. This role requires a leader who combines technical credibility with strong business acumen, excellent communication skills and the ability to achieve results through people.

Key Responsibilities

Leadership
• Lead and develop the operations organization, creating an environment focused on strong leadership, people development and high performance.
• Build a culture centered on safety, accountability, collaboration and continuous improvement.
• Ensure the organization has the capabilities and competencies required to support both current operations and future business needs.
• Drive organizational development and operational excellence across the business.
• Recruit, develop and retain high-performing leaders and technical teams.

Client Relationship
• Serve as the primary executive point of contact for the client regarding operational and business matters.
• Build and maintain a trusted, long-term relationship through proactive communication and operational excellence.
• Lead operational and business review meetings with the client.
• Ensure transparent communication and effective stakeholder management across the client's organization.
• Understand the client's business objectives and translate them into operational priorities.
• Act as the bridge between the client, internal teams and external service providers to ensure seamless delivery.
• Ensure a consistently high level of client satisfaction through collaboration, responsiveness and continuous improvement.

Operations
• Provide overall leadership for the safe, reliable and efficient operation of critical facilities.
• Ensure high availability through structured maintenance programs, operational planning and risk management.
• Oversee the operation and maintenance strategy for critical electrical, mechanical and life safety systems.
• Ensure compliance with applicable legislation, industry standards, company procedures and client requirements.
• Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on resilience, efficiency and operational performance.
• Lead operational response during critical incidents and ensure effective business continuity planning.

title: Jr. Critical Facilities Technician (CFTJ)
description:
The Junior Critical Facilities Technician (JCFT) is responsible for all aspects of data center operations throughout the year.  They will participate in an unwavering attitude and commitment to safety and reliability within the Data Center. The CFT will drive continual improvements to the operational excellence of the data center by adhering to company standards and industry best practices.  They will have a mindset of ongoing learning and development.

RESPONSIBILITIES
·        Assist with operating and maintaining critical and non-critical data center infrastructure, equipment, and systems
·        Work with a team of CFTs to deliver total availability (100% uptime) while minimizing risks
·        Assist with monitoring power, cooling capacity, and environmental conditions within the data halls
·        Utilize a Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS) as a tool to manage all planned and unplanned data center work
·        Work under supervision to perform preventive maintenance on data center electrical and mechanical equipment
·        Assist with the development, revision, and execution of approximately 200 operating procedures and preventive maintenance inspections, and perform quality control reviews to ensure accuracy, clarity, and continual improvement
·        Assist with the development of Data Center standards and policies when necessary
·        Support with the resolution of all electrical and mechanical issues within the Data Center quickly while minimizing risk and properly communicate issues to the appropriate chain of command
·        Help troubleshoot and document technical issues, escalates as appropriate, and ensure issue resolution
·        Assist with planning on all corrective issues
·        Assist and/or complete physical and logical installations of T5 services
·        Maintain accurate facility data including, rounds, PM work orders, change management, etc.
·        Maintain strict adherence to change control activities
·        Manage assigned workflow tasks in order to provide timely turnaround
·        Escort and work effectively with outside contractors, ensure they are abiding by critical facility work rules
·        Complete facility rounds at the beginning of each shift to ensure data center and grounds upkeep
·        Follow T5 data center corporate policies and procedures
·        Participate in facility training programs on a regular basis
·        Assist in facility operations, as required
·        Participate in construction and commissioning, as directed by the CFM
·        Work shifts to support 24x7 data center operation, and have flexibility in work hours to cover other shifts
·        Adhere to all federal, state, and local safety laws
·        Complete other such duties consistent with your role as you may be assigned by T5FM management

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE
·        High school degree or equivalent, required
·        Enrolled or ability to enroll in a Mission Critical diploma level program
·        Prior military or technical school training, preferred

Additional Information:
TOTAL COMPENSATION
$54,000-$65,000
Bonus eligible
Benefits: Medical, dental, vision, 401k w/ match
PTO and Paid Holiday

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, ABILITIES, AND COMPETENCIES
·        Strong verbal and written communication skills required for working effectively with CFM, team members, vendors and customers on daily data center management
·        Good written technical proficiency to support the creation and revision of process documentation (MOPs, SOPs, and EOPs)
·        Above average problem-solving and analysis skills for evaluating a situation, identifying solutions, and working with leadership and teammates to resolve
·        Embraces a team-based mentality by building positive morale and team spirit, supporting teammates efforts to succeed, and recognizing teammates accomplishments
·        Able to function effectively and maintain focus in high-pressure situations
·        Has a “can-do” customer service attitude who is conscientious and takes personal pride in their work
·        Has high degree of attention to detail and completes tasks on time
·        Able to follow instructions, respond to management direction, and volunteer readily when asked
·        Able to handle changing needs and priorities accurately and professionally
·        Able to read and understand electrical and mechanical manuals, drawings, and sketches
·        Able to work proficiently and safely with hand tools and power tools

About the Role

T5 is looking for a  Senior Critical Facilities Technician – Construction Integration  to join our Facilities Management team in Viborg.

This role sits at the intersection of  critical facility operations and construction delivery . You will represent Facilities Management / Operations in construction coordination activities and act as a key operational interface between the General Contractor, Project Management, Commissioning teams, and site Operations.

You will play an important role in ensuring that new and modified critical infrastructure is safely integrated, properly commissioned, fully documented, and ready for operational handover.

What You’ll Do

-
Serve as the day-to-day operational liaison with the General Contractor and coordinate construction activities around site operational requirements.

-
Review construction schedules, RAMS, scopes of work, and supporting technical documentation.

-
Plan, coordinate, and execute switching and isolation activities associated with construction work.

-
Prepare, submit, and track construction-related change requests through the site change-management process.

-
Develop and maintain technical procedures, including MOPs, SOPs, and EOPs.

-
Represent Facilities Management / Operations in construction and project coordination meetings.

-
Administer Permit-to-Work, Lockout-Tagout, hot work, and fire-watch processes for contractor activity in critical spaces.

-
Support management of fire and life-safety system impairments resulting from construction activity.

-
